g.text: Controller board, unit 1 (architecture rev C, D-51, D-55 to D-58). Stacked above the RF board; J2 plugs onto RF board J14.

g.desc: Controller board, unit 1 (architecture rev C, D-51, D-55 to D-58). Stacked above the RF board; J2 plugs onto RF board J14.

g.text: RJ45 LINK on the top wall: Cat6 #1 to the shack, T568B, four opto current loops (L1 data in, L2 PTT, L3 KILL, L4 data out).

g.desc: RJ45 LINK on the top wall: Cat6 #1 to the shack, T568B, four opto current loops (L1 data in, L2 PTT, L3 KILL, L4 data out).

g.text: Labels WDI, MCU_EN, LATCH_CLR and RLY_EN: safety gate (external watchdog, supply supervisor, fault latch), not drawn yet.

g.desc: Labels WDI, MCU_EN, LATCH_CLR and RLY_EN: safety gate (external watchdog, supply supervisor, fault latch), not drawn yet.

g.text: RLY_EN has its 100k pull-down on the RF board: with no gate fitted all relays stay off.
